title: Majalis Muharram 1446-2024 — Kanodar, Gujarat
description: Complete series of Majalis delivered during Muharram 1446 (2024) in Kanodar, Gujarat by Ayatullah Syed Sibtain Abbas Rizvi. The discourses expound upon the divine mission of Imam Husain (a.s.), the lessons of Karbala, Islamic theological foundations, and righteous conduct.
highlights: The theological and ethical dimensions of Karbala
The station and virtues of Ahlulbayt (a.s.) in the Quran

title: Safeer e Nijaat — QAIM TV Broadcast
description: Scholarly lectures and televised discourses from the acclaimed 'Safeer e Nijaat' series on QAIM TV, featuring Ayatullah Syed Sibtain Abbas Rizvi addressing fundamental Islamic beliefs, spiritual development, and practical religious jurisprudence.
highlights: The Path of Salvation (Safeer e Nijaat)
Practical rulings on Prayer, Purity & Islamic living
Cultivating devotion to the Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali (a.s.)

title: Safeer E Nijaat — Zulfiqar TV Broadcast
description: Comprehensive discourse series aired on Zulfiqar TV detailing core religious tenets, moral rectitude (Akhlaq), obedience to Allah (s.w.t.) and His Messenger (s.a.w.w.), and practical jurisprudential guidance for the believers.
highlights: Morality and high character according to Masoomeen (a.s.)
Islamic solutions to family and community questions
Clear scholarly exposition by Ayatullah Syed Sibtain Abbas Rizvi
